prompt: Dome lab 3:14AM. Screen blue, server green lights. Training log scrolls, tick like heartbeat. Then STOPS. 782ms COMPLETE SILENCE. title: 沉默—冰点
camera: 远景负空间→季深独白近景→沙子画冰点曲线(海浪冲掉→再画→再冲掉)→手指敲击特写→涟漪特写→【flash cut2s暗红节点】
lighting: 金色→橙色→紫色→切黑→暗红节点flash cut
prompt: Sea dusk. Ji Shen alone on rock. 'Have I figured out what emergence is?' 5s silence. '没有。' '我只知道——涌现是真实的。那些点在聚。有方向的。' Pause. 'But direction drift—it's not sudden. 0.02 degrees each time. Fourteen months. Everything looks normal.' He draws a curve in the sand — finger from top-left to bottom-right. 'Until the freezing point.' He marks a point. Wave washes it away. He draws again. Wave again. He stops. Subtitle card: 'Freezing point—the water molecules are still there, but they no longer flow.' Finger taps knee. Ripple syncs. Note: natural silence (waves present, music absent). Then BLACK. FLASH CUT 2s: 全球分布图。暗红节点亮起。像血在水里扩散。SOUND: Low brass horn half a second, then CUT.
